<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:center;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The primary purpose of the investment portfolio is to generate income, diversify earning assets, and meet liquidity needs of the Company through readily saleable financial instruments. The portfolio is made up primarily of fixed rate bonds, whose prices move inversely with rates. At the end of any accounting period, the investment portfolio has unrealized gains and losses. The Company monitors the portfolio, which is subject to liquidity needs, market rate changes, and credit risk changes, to see if adjustments are needed. The primary concern in a loss situation is the credit quality of the business or entity behind the instrument. The primary cause of unrealized losses is the increase in market interest rates over the yields available at the time the securities were purchased.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017</em><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">, the Company does <em data-td-fact-id="28528477" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> consider any security in an unrealized loss position to be other-than-temporarily impaired.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><u><i>U.S. Government agency securities</i></u><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><i>. </i>The unrealized losses on <em data-td-fact-id="28528478" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">twenty-four</em> of the Company&rsquo;s investments in obligations of the U.S. government were caused by increases in market interest rates over the yields available at the time the securities were purchased.&nbsp;&nbsp;The contractual terms of those investments do <em data-td-fact-id="28528479" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> permit the issuer to settle the securities at a price less than the amortized cost basis of the investments. The Company does <em data-td-fact-id="28528480" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> consider those investments to be other-than-temporarily impaired at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><u><i>Mortgage-backed securities and CMO<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s</font></i></u><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><i>. </i>The unrealized losses on <em data-td-fact-id="28528481" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">thirty-five</em> of the Company&rsquo;s investments in government-sponsored entity mortgage-backed securities were caused by increases in market interest rates over the yields available at the time the securities were purchased.&nbsp;&nbsp;Because the decline in market value is attributable to changes in interest rates and <em data-td-fact-id="28528482" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> credit quality, the Company does <em data-td-fact-id="28528483" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> consider those investments to be other-than-temporarily impaired at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><u><i>Corporate securities</i></u><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">. The unrealized losses on <em data-td-fact-id="28528484" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em> of the Company&rsquo;s investments in corporate securities were caused by increases in market interest rates over the yield available at the time the security was purchased. Because the decline in market value is attributable to changes in interest rates and <em data-td-fact-id="28528485" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> credit quality, the Company does <em data-td-fact-id="28528486" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> consider this investment to be other-than-temporarily impaired at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><u><i>Municipal securities</i></u><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><i>. </i>The unrealized losses on <em data-td-fact-id="28528487" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">six</em> of the Company&rsquo;s investments in obligations of municipal securities were caused by increases in market interest rates over the yields available at the time the securities were purchased. All municipal securities are investment grade. Because the decline in market value is attributable to changes in interest rates and credit spreads, and <em data-td-fact-id="28528488" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> credit quality, the Company does <em data-td-fact-id="28528489" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> consider those investments to be other-than-temporarily impaired at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

The Company realized <em data-td-fact-id="28528497" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$69</em> thousand in net gains on sales of <em data-td-fact-id="28528498" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">forty-five</em> available for sale securities in <em data-td-fact-id="28528499" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> compared to <em data-td-fact-id="28528500" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$257</em> thousand from the sales of <em data-td-fact-id="28528501" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">fourteen</em> securities&nbsp;in the prior year.&nbsp;&nbsp;The net gain in <em data-td-fact-id="28528502" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> included gross gains of <em data-td-fact-id="28528503" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$170</em> thousand net of gross losses of <em data-td-fact-id="28528504" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$101</em> thousand. The prior year included gross gains of <em data-td-fact-id="28528505" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$262</em> thousand and gross losses of <em data-td-fact-id="28528506" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$5</em> thousand. Total pledged securities had a fair market value of <em data-td-fact-id="28528507" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$4.0</em> million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="28528508" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$6.2</em> million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2016. </em>At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>securities having a fair market value of <em data-td-fact-id="28528509" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$2.3</em> million were pledged to secure public deposits, securities pledged to secure Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings totaled <em data-td-fact-id="28528510" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$112</em> thousand, and <em data-td-fact-id="28528511" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.6</em> million in securities were pledged for other purposes.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Troubled Debt Restructurings</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em><em data-td-fact-id="28528522" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">four</em> loans totaling <em data-td-fact-id="28528523" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$4.1</em><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> million were classified as troubled debt restructurings (&ldquo;TDRs&rdquo;). Two of the <em data-td-fact-id="28528524" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">four</em> loans totaling <em data-td-fact-id="28528525" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$3.9</em> million were performing in accordance with their restructured terms and were <em data-td-fact-id="28528526" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> on nonaccrual status at year end <em data-td-fact-id="28528527" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017.</em> The other <em data-td-fact-id="28528528" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em> loans from <em data-td-fact-id="28528529" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> borrower totaled <em data-td-fact-id="28528530" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$219</em> thousand and were on nonaccrual status at year end <em data-td-fact-id="28528531" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017.</em> All <em data-td-fact-id="28528532" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">four</em> TDRs were current with their restructured terms at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017. </em></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2016, </em><em data-td-fact-id="28528533" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">five</em> loans totaling <em data-td-fact-id="28528534" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$6.4</em><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> million were classified as troubled debt restructurings. Three of the <em data-td-fact-id="28528535" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">five</em> loans totaling <em data-td-fact-id="28528536" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$6.2</em> million were performing in accordance with their restructured terms and were <em data-td-fact-id="28528537" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> on nonaccrual status at year end <em data-td-fact-id="28528538" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em> The other <em data-td-fact-id="28528539" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em> loans from <em data-td-fact-id="28528540" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> borrower totaled <em data-td-fact-id="28528541" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$231</em> thousand and were on nonaccrual status at year end <em data-td-fact-id="28528542" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em> All <em data-td-fact-id="28528543" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">five</em> TDRs were current with their restructured terms at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2016.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">There was <em data-td-fact-id="28528544" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> valuation allowance related to<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> total TDRs at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>or <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2016.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><em data-td-fact-id="28528545" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No</em> loans were modified in a TDR during the year<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">s ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>or <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2016.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Management considers troubled debt restructurings and subsequent defaults in restructured loans in the determination of the adequacy of the Company<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s allowance for loan losses.&nbsp;&nbsp;When identified as a TDR, a loan is evaluated for potential loss based on the present value of expected future cash flows discounted at the loan&rsquo;s effective interest rate, the loan&rsquo;s observable market price, or the estimated fair value of the collateral, less any selling costs if the loan is collateral dependent.&nbsp;&nbsp;Loans identified as TDRs frequently are on non-accrual status at the time of the restructuring and, in some cases, partial charge-offs <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>have already been taken against the loan and a specific allowance <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>have already been established for the loan.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result of any modification as a TDR, the specific reserve associated with the loan <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be increased.&nbsp;&nbsp;Additionally, loans modified in a TDR are closely monitored for delinquency as an early indicator of possible future defaults.&nbsp;&nbsp;If loans modified in a TDR subsequently default, the Company evaluates the loan for possible further impairment.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result, any specific allowance <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be increased, adjustments <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be made in the allocation of the total allowance balance, or partial charge-offs <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be taken to further write-down the carrying value of the loan.&nbsp;&nbsp;Management exercises significant judgment in developing estimates for potential losses associated with TDRs.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><b>&nbsp;</b></p>
</div>

<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="11953" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521667290260" id="thunderdome-statement-828811">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="28528546" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">4.</em> Allowance for Loan Losses</b></font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The following table p<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">resents, as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>the total allowance for loan losses, the allowance by impairment methodology (individually evaluated for impairment or collectively evaluated for impairment), the total loans and loans by impairment methodology (individually evaluated for impairment or collectively evaluated for impairment).</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-taggable-table="table" data-td-v2v-id="1521667290250" id="thunderdome-statement-828812">
<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" class="finTable" id="null" style="width: 100%; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; text-indent: 0px;">

		<tr style="vertical-align: bottom;">
			<td style="text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 0pt; width: 14%;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b>December 31, 2017</b><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
			</td>
			<td id=".lead.D8" style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 1%;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td colspan="26" id=".amt.D8" style="text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 0pt; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(0, 0, 0); width: 1.51115e24%;">

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Leases</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The Company currently leases its main office under a non-cancelable lease agreement. The lease has a <em data-td-fact-id="28528563" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">ten</em>-year term and expires on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2025. </em>The agreement provides an option to extend the lease for <em data-td-fact-id="28528564" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> additional <em data-td-fact-id="28528565" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">ten</em>-year term at expiration. Terms of the new agreement provide for an annual rental increase, beginning <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> January 1, 2017, </em>based on a published inflation index, <em data-td-fact-id="28528566" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> to exceed <em data-td-fact-id="28528567" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> percent over the rent for the immediately preceding lease year. The Company currently leases a branch location under a non-cancelable lease agreement. The original lease expired on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> July 31, 2016. </em>The lease was renewed for <em data-td-fact-id="28528568" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> additional term of <em data-td-fact-id="28528569" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">ten</em> years and it provides an option to extend the lease for <em data-td-fact-id="28528570" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em> additional, consecutive <em data-td-fact-id="28528571" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">five</em>-year terms. The newly negotiated lease expires <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> July 31, 2026. </em>The Company currently leases space to operate an automated teller machine under a non-cancelable lease agreement. The term of the <em data-td-fact-id="28528572" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">eight</em> year lease commenced on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> April 1, 2013 </em>and expires on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> April 1, 2021. </em>The lease provides an option to extend the term for <em data-td-fact-id="28528573" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em> additional <em data-td-fact-id="28528574" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">five</em>-year periods. Terms of the agreement provide for an annual rental increase of <em data-td-fact-id="28528575" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> percent over the rent for the immediately preceding lease year. <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">HomeTown Residential Mortgage, LLC leases space in Roanoke and Christiansburg for its mortgage operations. Both leases are for a term of <em data-td-fact-id="28528576" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">twelve</em> months and renew under the same terms unless <em data-td-fact-id="28528577" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">60</em> days&rsquo; notice is provided by the lessor or the Company. The Roanoke lease expires every <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> May 31 </em>and the Christiansburg lease expires every <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> September 30.</em></font></p>

<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="11958" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521667336454" id="thunderdome-statement-828828">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="28528603" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">9.</em> Subordinated Notes</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">On <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 18, 2015, </em>the Company completed the issuance of <em data-td-fact-id="28528604" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$7.5</em> million in aggregate principal amount of fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes in a private placement transaction to various institutional accredited investors. The net proceeds of the offering are intended to support growth and be used for other general business purposes. The notes have a maturity date of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 30, 2025 </em>and have an annual fixed interest rate of <em data-td-fact-id="28528605" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">6.75%</em> until <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 30, 2020. </em>Thereafter, the notes will have a floating interest rate based on LIBOR. Interest will be paid semi-annually, in arrears, on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30 </em>and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 30 </em>of each year during the time that the notes remain outstanding through the fixed interest rate period or earlier redemption date. Interest will be paid quarterly, in arrears, on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> March 30, </em><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30, </em><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> September 30 </em>and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 30 </em>throughout the floating interest rate period or earlier redemption date.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The indebtedness evidenced by the notes, including principal and interest, is unsecured and subordinate and junior in right of the Company<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s payments to general and secured creditors and depositors of its wholly owned subsidiary, HomeTown Bank.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The notes are redeemable, without penalty, on or after <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 30, 2020 </em>and, in certain limited circumstances, prior to that date.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The notes limit the Company from declaring or paying any dividend, or making any distribution on capital stock or other equity securities of any kind of the Company if the Company is <em data-td-fact-id="28528611" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> &ldquo;well capitalized&rdquo; for regulatory purposes, immediately prior to the declaration of such dividend or distribution, except for dividends payable solely in shares of common stock of the Company.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Securities sold under agreements to repurchase are secured transactions with customers and generally mature the day following the day sold. Short-term borrowings <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>also include federal funds purchased, which are unsecured overnight borrowings from other financial institutions. The warehouse line of credit is a short-term revolving credit facility used to fund mortgage loans originations until the underlying loan is sold. The amount borrowed on the <em data-td-fact-id="28528614" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$5.0</em> million warehouse line of<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> credit was <em data-td-fact-id="28528615" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.6</em> million at year end <em data-td-fact-id="28528616" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> at a rate of LIBOR plus <em data-td-fact-id="28528617" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2.75%.</em> The Company had <em data-td-fact-id="28528618" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$36.5</em> million of federal funds lines of credit available at year-end <em data-td-fact-id="28528619" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017.</em> In addition, the Company had access to a <em data-td-fact-id="28528620" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$10.0</em> million credit line through Promontory&rsquo;s Insured Cash Sweep (ICS) <em data-td-fact-id="28528621" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> way buy program at a rate of the <em data-td-fact-id="28528622" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> month LIBOR plus <em data-td-fact-id="28528623" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">11</em> basis points but <em data-td-fact-id="28528624" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> less than <em data-td-fact-id="28528625" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">20</em> basis points. At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="28528626" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> there were <em data-td-fact-id="28528627" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> advances on the federal funds or credit lines. </font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521667359684" id="thunderdome-statement-828833">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="28528629" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">11.</em> Fair Value Measurements</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The Company uses a hierarchy of valuation techniques based on whether the inputs to those valuation techniques are observable or unobservable. Observable inputs reflect market data obtained from independent sources, while unobservable inputs reflect the Company<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s market assumptions. The <em data-td-fact-id="28528630" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> levels of the fair value hierarchy based on these <em data-td-fact-id="28528631" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em> types of inputs are as follows:</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Level <em data-td-fact-id="28528632" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1</em> - Valuation is based on quoted prices in active markets for identical assets and liabilities.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Level <em data-td-fact-id="28528633" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2</em> - Valuation is based on observable inputs, including quoted prices in active markets for similar assets and liabilities, quoted prices for identical or similar assets and liabilities in less active markets, and model-based valuation techniques for which significant assumptions can be derived primarily from or corroborated by observable data in the market.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Level <em data-td-fact-id="28528634" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">3</em> - Valuation is based on model-based techniques that use <em data-td-fact-id="28528635" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> or more significant inputs or assumptions that are unobservable in the market.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The following describes the valuation techniques used by the Company to measure certain financial assets and liabilities recorded at fair value on a recurring basis in the consolidated financial statements:</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><u>Securities available for sale: </u><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">Securities available for sale are recorded at fair value on a recurring basis. Fair value measurement is based upon quoted market prices, when available (Level <em data-td-fact-id="28528636" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1</em>). If quoted market prices are <em data-td-fact-id="28528637" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> available, fair values are measured utilizing independent valuation techniques of identical or similar securities for which significant assumptions are derived primarily from or corroborated by observable market data. Third-party vendors compile prices from various sources and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>determine the fair value of identical or similar securities by using pricing models that consider observable market data (Level <em data-td-fact-id="28528638" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2</em>).</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The following tables present the balances of financial assets and liabilities measured at fair value on a recurring basis <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="28528639" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016:</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Certain assets are measured at fair value on a nonrecurring basis in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP). Adjustments to the fair value of these assets usually result from the application of lower-of-cost-or-market accounting or write-downs of individual assets.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The following describes the valuation techniques used by the Company to measure certain assets recorded at fair value on a nonrecurring basis in the consolidated financial statements:</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-left: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt">
<div id="PGNUM" style="text-align: center; width: 100%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">46</div>

<hr style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000">
<div id="PGHDR" style="text-align: left; width: 100%"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></div>
</div>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><u>Impaired Loans:</u><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> The Company does <em data-td-fact-id="28528640" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> record loans at fair value on a recurring basis. However, from time to time a loan is considered impaired and a specific reserve is established. Loans for which it is probable that payment of interest and principal will <em data-td-fact-id="28528641" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> be made in accordance with the contractual terms of the loan agreement are considered impaired. Once a loan is identified as individually impaired, management measures the extent of any loss. The fair value of impaired loans is estimated using <em data-td-fact-id="28528642" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> of several methods, including collateral value, market value of similar debt, enterprise value, liquidation value, and discounted cash flow. Those impaired loans <em data-td-fact-id="28528643" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> requiring an allowance represent loans for which the fair value of the expected repayments or collateral exceed the recorded investment in such loans. Impaired loans where an allowance is established based on the fair value of collateral require classification in the fair value hierarchy. If carried at market price based on appraised value using observable market data, it is recorded as nonrecurring Level <em data-td-fact-id="28528644" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2.</em> When an appraised value is <em data-td-fact-id="28528645" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> available or management determines the fair value of the collateral is further impaired below the appraisal value and there is <em data-td-fact-id="28528646" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> observable market price, the Company records the impaired loan as nonrecurring Level <em data-td-fact-id="28528647" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">3.</em> </font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><u>Loans held for sale:</u><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> The carrying value of these loans approximates the fair value. These loans close in the name of the Bank&rsquo;s consolidated joint venture subsidiary HomeTown Residential Mortgage, LLC, but are generally sold within a <em data-td-fact-id="28528648" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em>-week period.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><u>Other Real Estate Owned (OREO)</u><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">: The carrying amount of real estate owned by the Company resulting from foreclosures is estimated at the lesser of cost or the fair value of the real estate based on an observable market price or a current appraised value less selling costs. If carried at market price based on appraised value using observable market data, it is recorded as nonrecurring Level <em data-td-fact-id="28528649" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2.</em> When an appraised value is <em data-td-fact-id="28528650" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> available or is <em data-td-fact-id="28528651" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> current, or management determines the fair value of the real estate is further impaired below the appraised value or there is <em data-td-fact-id="28528652" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> observable market price, the Company records the real estate as nonrecurring Level <em data-td-fact-id="28528653" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">3.</em> </font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The following table summarizes the Company<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s assets that were measured at fair value on a nonrecurring basis as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="28528654" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The following methods and assumptions were used by the Company in estimating its fair value disclosures for financial instruments:</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Cash and due from banks: The carrying amounts reported in the consolidated balance sheet for cash on hand and amounts due from correspondent banks approximate their fair values. The fair values for certificates of deposit are estimated using a discounted cash flow calculation that applies interest rates currently being offered on certificates of deposit to a schedule of contractual maturities on such time deposits.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Federal funds sold: Federal funds sold consist of overnight loans to other financial institutions and mature within <em data-td-fact-id="28528660" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> to <em data-td-fact-id="28528661" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> days. Management believes the carrying value of federal funds sold approximates estimated market value.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Securities available for sale: Securities available for sale are recorded at fair value on a recurring basis. Fair value measurement is based upon quoted market prices, when available (Level <em data-td-fact-id="28528662" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1</em>). If quoted market prices are <em data-td-fact-id="28528663" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> available, fair values are measured utilizing independent valuation techniques of identical or similar securities for which significant assumptions are derived primarily from or corroborated by observable market data. Third-party vendors compile prices from various sources and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>determine the fair value of identical or similar securities by using pricing models that consider observable market data (Level <em data-td-fact-id="28528664" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2</em>).</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Restricted equity securities: For these restricted equity securities, the carrying amount is a reasonable estimate of fair value based on the redemption provisions of the related securities.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Loans held for sale: The carrying value of these loans approximates the fair value. These loans close in the name of the bank<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s joint venture subsidiary HomeTown Residential Mortgage, LLC, but are generally sold within a <em data-td-fact-id="28528665" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em>-week period.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Loans receivable: For variable-rate loans that reprice frequently and with <em data-td-fact-id="28528666" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> significant change in credit risk, fair values are based on carrying amounts. The fair values for other loans are estimated using discounted cash flow analysis, based on interest rates currently being offered for loans with similar terms to borrowers of similar credit quality.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Bank owned life insurance: The cash values of these policies are estimates using information provided by insurance carriers. The policies are carried at their cash surrender value, which approximates fair value.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Deposit liabilities: The fair values disclosed for demand and savings deposits are, by definition, equal to the amount payable on demand at the reporting date. The fair values for certificates of deposit are estimated using a discounted cash flow calculation that applies interest rates currently being offered on certificates of deposit to a schedule of contractual maturities on such time deposits.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Short-term borrowings: The carrying amounts of federal funds purchased, borrowings under repurchase agreements, and other short-term borrowings maturing within <em data-td-fact-id="28528667" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">30</em> days approximate their fair values.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">FHLB borrowings: The fair values for FHLB borrowings are estimated using a discounted cash flow calculation that applies interest rates currently being offered on FHLB borrowings to the contractual maturities on such FHLB borrowings.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Subordinated notes: The fair values is measured utilizing independent valuation techniques of identical or similar securities for which significant assumptions are derived primarily from or corroborated by observable market data. Third party vendors compile prices from various sources and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>determine the fair value of identical or similar securities by using pricing models that consider observable market data (Level <em data-td-fact-id="28528668" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2</em>).</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Accrued interest: The carrying amount of accrued interest receivable and payable approximates fair value.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Off-balance sheet financial instruments: The fair values of commitments to extend credit and standby letters of credit are estimated using the fees currently charged to enter into similar agreements. At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, </em><em data-td-fact-id="28528669" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">201</em><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="28528670" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">7</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="28528671" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> the fair value of loan commitments and standby letters of credit was deemed to be immaterial.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521667375865" id="thunderdome-statement-828842">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="28528672" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">12.</em> Earnings per Common Share</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The following tables show the weighted average number of shares used in computing earnings per common share and the effect on weighted average number of shares of diluted potential common stock. Potential dilutive common stock had <em data-td-fact-id="28528673" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> effect on income available to common shareholders for the year<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">s ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="28528674" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> as all of the Series C Preferred Stock was converted to common stock during <em data-td-fact-id="28528675" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em> </font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-taggable-table="table" data-td-v2v-id="1521667375863" id="thunderdome-statement-828843">
<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" class="finTable" id="null" style="width: 100%; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; text-indent: 0px;">

		<tr style="vertical-align: bottom;">
			<td style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 34%;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td id=".lead.D7" style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 1%;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td colspan="22" id=".amt.D7" style="text-align: center; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 0pt; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(0, 0, 0); width: 1.81118e+20%;">

<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="11962" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521667384737" id="thunderdome-statement-828844">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="28528679" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">13.</em> Stock Based Compensation</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The Company recorded stock ba<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">sed compensation expense of <em data-td-fact-id="28528680" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$148</em> thousand and <em data-td-fact-id="28528681" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$147</em> thousand for the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="28528682" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> respectively.</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The <em data-td-fact-id="28528683" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2005</em> Stock Option Plan (the Plan) pursuant to which the Board of Directors granted stock options to directors, officers and employees expired in <em data-td-fact-id="28528684" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> thus there are <em data-td-fact-id="28528685" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> options available for future i<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">ssuance. Under the fair value recognition provisions of relevant accounting guidance, stock-based compensation cost&nbsp;was measured at the grant date based on the fair value of the award and&nbsp;was and continues to be&nbsp;recognized as expense on a straight-line basis over the requisite service period, which is the vesting period.&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The Company used the Black-Scholes option pricing model to determine the fair value of stock options. The fair value of the stock based payment awards<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;was affected by the price of the Company&#39;s stock and a number of financial assumptions and variables. These variables included the risk-free interest rate, expected dividend rate, expected stock price volatility and the expected life of the options.&nbsp; <em data-td-fact-id="28528686" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No</em> stock options were granted during <em data-td-fact-id="28528687" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> or <em data-td-fact-id="28528688" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em> Compensation expense is charged to income ratably over the vesting period and was <em data-td-fact-id="28528689" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$71</em> thousand in <em data-td-fact-id="28528690" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="28528691" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$75</em> thousand in <em data-td-fact-id="28528692" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em> As of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>there was <em data-td-fact-id="28528693" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$140</em> thousand of total unrecognized compensation cost related to nonvested stock options granted under the Plan. The cost will be recognized over the next <em data-td-fact-id="28528694" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">two</em> years.&nbsp; At the discretion of the Board of Directors, the stock option plan was <em data-td-fact-id="28528695" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> modified for the <em data-td-fact-id="28528696" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">4%</em> stock dividend distributed on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> July 11, 2016</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">A summary of option activity under the <em data-td-fact-id="28528697" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2005</em> stock option plan during the year ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31</em><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">, <em data-td-fact-id="28528698" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> is as follows:</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">(<em data-td-fact-id="28528699" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1</em>) The aggregate intrinsic value of a stock option in the table above represents the total pre-tax intrinsic value (the amount by which the current market value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of the option) that would have been received by the option holders had all option holders exercised th<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">eir options on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">In <em data-td-fact-id="28528700" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2009,</em> the Board of Directors authorized <em data-td-fact-id="28528701" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">137,280</em><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> shares, restated for the <em data-td-fact-id="28528702" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">4%</em> stock dividend distributed <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> July 11, 2016, </em>of common stock for issuance under the Restricted Stock Plan. The plan provides for restricted stock awards to key employees. Restricted shares awarded to employees generally vest over a <em data-td-fact-id="28528703" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">five</em>-year period and compensation expense is charged to income ratably over the vesting period and was <em data-td-fact-id="28528704" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$77</em> thousand in <em data-td-fact-id="28528705" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="28528706" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$72</em> thousand in <em data-td-fact-id="28528707" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em> Compensation is accounted for using the fair market value of the Company&rsquo;s common stock on the date the restricted shares are awarded. The weighted-average grant date fair value of restricted stock granted in <em data-td-fact-id="28528708" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> was <em data-td-fact-id="28528709" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$10.24</em> compared to <em data-td-fact-id="28528710" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$9.09*</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="28528711" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em>&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company granted <em data-td-fact-id="28528712" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">13,258</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="28528713" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">11,149*</em> shares of restricted stock under the plan in <em data-td-fact-id="28528714" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="28528715" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> respectively.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="11963" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521667392173" id="thunderdome-statement-828847">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="28528719" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">14.</em> Salary Continuation Plan</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The Company has a Salary Continuation Plan for certain key officers. The plan provides the participating officers with supplemental retirement income. The Supplemental Executive Retirement Plan (the &ldquo;SERP&rdquo;) provides lifetime payments equal to <em data-td-fact-id="28528720" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">20%</em> of a participant<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s average annual base salary for the <em data-td-fact-id="28528721" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">five</em> years immediately prior to retirement. There is an incentive formula with an additional benefit of <em data-td-fact-id="28528722" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">20%</em> of a participant&rsquo;s average annual base salary for the <em data-td-fact-id="28528723" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">five</em> years immediately prior to retirement if performance targets set by the Board of Directors are met. The SERP contains provisions for disability and survivor benefits, a benefits vesting schedule based on age attained and automatic full vesting in the event of a change in control of the Company. During <em data-td-fact-id="28528724" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> the SERP was increased to provide for the individual who filled the position of Chief Financial Officer (CFO), upon the former CFO&rsquo;s retirement. Accrued deferred compensation expense under the SERP, included in other liabilities, totaled <em data-td-fact-id="28528725" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.0</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="28528726" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$666</em> thousand at the end of <em data-td-fact-id="28528727" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="28528728" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> respectively. Compensation expense related to the SERP was <em data-td-fact-id="28528729" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$357</em> thousand for <em data-td-fact-id="28528730" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> compared to <em data-td-fact-id="28528731" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$351</em> thousand for <em data-td-fact-id="28528732" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em> The funding mechanism for the plan is Bank Owned Life Insurance policies on the lives of the participants. </font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>
</div>

<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="11964" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521667400052" id="thunderdome-statement-828848">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="28528733" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">15.</em> Employee Benefit Plan</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The Company adopted a profit sharing plan pursuant to Section <em data-td-fact-id="28528734" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">401</em>(k) of the Internal Revenue Code. The plan covers substantially all employees. Participants <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>contribute a percentage of compensation, subject to a maximum allowed under the Code. The Company makes non-discretionary matching contributions of <em data-td-fact-id="28528735" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">100%</em> of the employee<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s deferral up to <em data-td-fact-id="28528736" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">3%</em> of compensation and matches <em data-td-fact-id="28528737" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">50%</em> of the employee&rsquo;s next <em data-td-fact-id="28528738" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">3%</em> deferral. In addition, the Company <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>make additional contributions at the discretion of the Board of Directors. The Company&rsquo;s matching contributions were <em data-td-fact-id="28528739" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$263</em> thousand and <em data-td-fact-id="28528740" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$240</em> thousand for the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="28528741" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> respectively.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>
</div>

<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="11965" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Rate Reconciliation</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1521667417282" id="thunderdome-statement-828853">
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><b>Note <em data-td-fact-id="28528758" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">17.</em> Commitments and Contingencies</b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Litigation</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">In the normal course of business, the Company becomes involved in litigation arising from the banking, financial and other activities it conducts. Management, after consultation with legal counsel, does <em data-td-fact-id="28528759" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> anticipate that the ultimate liability, if any, arising from these matters will have a material effect on the Company<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s financial condition, operating results or liquidity.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Credit Related Financial Instruments</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The Company is party to credit related financial instruments with off-balance-sheet risk in the normal course of business to meet the financing needs of its customers. These financial instruments include commitments to extend credit and standby letters of credit. These instruments involve, to varying degrees, credit risk in excess of the amount recognized in the consolidated balance sheet.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The Company<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s exposure to credit loss, in the event of nonperformance by the other party to the financial instrument, for commitments to extend credit and standby letters of credit is represented by the contractual amount of those instruments. The Company uses the same credit policies in making commitments and conditional obligations as it does for on-balance-sheet instruments.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Commitments to extend credit are agreements to lend to a customer as long as there is <em data-td-fact-id="28528761" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> violation of any condition established in the contract. Commitments generally have fixed expiration dates or other termination clauses and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>require payment of a fee. Since many of the commitments are expected to expire without being drawn upon, the total commitment amounts do <em data-td-fact-id="28528762" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> necessarily represent future cash requirements. The Company evaluates each customer<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s creditworthiness on a case-by-case basis. The amount of collateral obtained, if deemed necessary by the Company upon extension of credit, is based on management&rsquo;s credit evaluation of the party. Collateral held varies, but <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>include accounts receivable, inventory, property and equipment, residential real estate and income-producing commercial properties.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Standby letters of credit are conditional commitments issued by the Company to guarantee the performance of a customer to a <em data-td-fact-id="28528763" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">third</em> party. Those guarantees are primarily issued to support public and private borrowing arrangements. The credit risk involved in issuing letters of credit is essentially the same as that involved in extending loan facilities to customers. Collateral held varies as specified above and is required in instances which the Company deems necessary.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The Company is required to maintain certain required reserve balances with the Federal Re<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">serve Bank. At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="28528764" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> these reserve balances amounted to <em data-td-fact-id="28528765" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$9.6</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="28528766" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$6.6</em> million, respectively.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">The Company from time to time <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>have cash and cash equivalents on deposit with financial institutions that exceed federally insured limits. Balances in excess of F<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">DIC insured amounts totaled <em data-td-fact-id="28528767" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$5.9</em> million and <em data-td-fact-id="28528768" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$7.2</em> million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="28528769" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> respectively.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">Purchase Obligation</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">O<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">n <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> November 1, 2015, </em>the Company entered into a <em data-td-fact-id="28528770" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> year marketing agreement involving naming, advertising, and sponsorship rights. This agreement was replaced with a new agreement effective <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> July 1, 2016. </em>The new term was for <em data-td-fact-id="28528771" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years, with options for a <em data-td-fact-id="28528772" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">fourth</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="28528773" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">fifth</em> year, and expanded the exclusivity of marketing rights and increased signage. In relation to these agreements, the Company expensed <em data-td-fact-id="28528774" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$55.0</em> thousand and <em data-td-fact-id="28528775" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$57.5</em> thousand in <em data-td-fact-id="28528776" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="28528777" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> respectively. The agreement obligates the Company to pay <em data-td-fact-id="28528778" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$65.0</em> thousand in <em data-td-fact-id="28528779" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="28528780" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$32.5</em> thousand for the <em data-td-fact-id="28528781" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em> half of <em data-td-fact-id="28528782" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2019</em> for these rights. </font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.5pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>
